title: singular Setup Report v0
description: The success half of the `singular setup` contract: what each step did, what was warned about, the state actually reached, and EXACTLY ONE next action. `state` is the highest state truthfully reached — 'stopped-ready' requires migration complete, historical gates verified, doctor passing, and a recorded PASSING regression run. Reaching 'validated' never implies the loop is running, and nothing here authorizes actuation.

status.description: ok = already correct; new = this run created it; skip = deliberately not done, with the reason in detail; warn = done, but something needs an operator's eye.

nextAction.description: The single command an operator should run next. There is exactly one, and the human output prints exactly one matching `Next:` line.

safeToActuate.description: True only in 'stopped-ready': everything was verified AND the repository is still stopped. Actuation remains a separate explicit operator action either way.
